riddle: Neela thaal, moti hazaar, sabke sar pe ulta taiyaar. Din mein moti chhup jaate, raat ko phir se jagmagaate. Batao, yeh ulta thaal kya hai?
hint: Upar dekho, raat ko aur maza aayega.

riddle: Raat ko aata, din mein jaata, kabhi poori roti, kabhi aadha tukda dikhlaata. Bachche isko mama kehke bulaate. Kaun hai woh?
hint: Raat ki shift pe duty karta hai.

riddle: Aasman se boond boond utroon, sookhi mitti ki saundhi khushboo jagaaun. Kaagaz ki naav chalwaaun, chhate khulwaaun, aur office jaane waalon ko traffic mein phasaaun. Kya hoon?
hint: June-July mein sabko iska intezaar hota hai.

riddle: Subah khidki se chupke se andar aaun. Sardi mein sab mujhe dhoondhein, garmi mein sab mujhse bhaagein. Chhat pe papad, achaar aur geele kapde mere bharose sookhein. Kya hoon?
hint: Sunscreen isi se bachaata hai.

riddle: Zameen ki hari chaadar, jitna kaato phir se ug aaun. Gaay ka naashta, subah os ki boondein mujh pe chamkein, aur park mein board lage ki mujh pe mat chalo. Kya hoon?
hint: Lawn mower iski hajaamat karta hai.

riddle: Samundar kinaare bachche mujhse mahal banaayein, registaan mein mere pahaad hi pahaad. Mutthi mein kas ke pakdo toh ungliyon ke beech se phisal jaaun. Kya hoon?
hint: Cement mein milaake deewar banti hai.

riddle: Main mitti ke andar chhupi rehti hoon, par poora ped mere sahaare khada hai. Paani main peeti hoon, pyaas patton ki bujhti hai. Aandhi aaye toh main hi ped ko pakad ke rakhti hoon. Kaun hoon?
hint: Kisi problem ki asli wajah ko bhi yahi kehte hain.

riddle: Mitti ka khula muh, pet mein lakdi aur uple bharo toh jalne lage. Sir pe handi chadhe. Gaon ki rasoi ka raja tha, gas cylinder aaya toh retire ho gaya. Kya hai?
hint: Is pe sikki roti ka swaad hi alag hota hai.

riddle: Aag ka beta, paida hote hi aasman ki taraf bhaage. Jitna upar jaaye utna gaayab, aankhon mein chubhe, khaansi laaye. Kya hai?
hint: Chimney se bahar nikalta hai.

riddle: Safed hoon par chuna nahi. Gas pe akela chhod do toh ubal ke bhaag jaaun. Dahi, paneer, ghee sab mere hi bachche, aur chai mere bina adhoori. Kya hoon?
hint: Raat ko haldi milaake peete hain.

riddle: Pahaad ki choti se kood jaaye par haddi na toote. Safed dhaar, lagaataar shor, aur neeche nahaane waalon ki bheed. Kya hai?
hint: Meghalaya aur Kerala mein bahut dikhenge.

riddle: Itna paani ki gin na paao, phir bhi pyaase ko ek ghoont na pila paao. Lehrein uth uth ke kinaare ko chhoo jaayein. Kya hai?
hint: Iska paani namkeen hai.

riddle: Na chale, na hile, sadiyon se ek jagah khada. Sir pe safed barf ki topi, chadhne wala haanfe bada. Kya hai?
hint: Himalaya inka sardaar hai.

riddle: Pair zameen ke andar gaade, haath aasman ki or phailaaye. Patthar khaaye phir bhi meethe phal khilaaye, dhoop mein chhaya de. Kaun hai?
hint: Iski chhaaon mein dopahar ki jhapki sabse achhi.

riddle: Keechad mein paida hua, phir bhi daag na laga. Paani pe tairta rahe, patte pe boond na tike. Bharat ka rashtriya phool hai. Kaun?
hint: Gulaabi pankhudiyaan, taalaab mein milta hai.

riddle: Gaon ke kinaare paani ka chhota sa katora, na nadi jaisa bahe na samundar jaisa namkeen. Mendhak tarraaye, kamal khile, aur bachche patthar phenk ke chhapak ginein. Kya hai?
hint: Bhainsein dopahar mein isme aaram karti hain.

riddle: Baarish ke baad gali mein mera raaj. Safed kapde dekh ke mujhe pyaar aa jaata hai aur main unse lipat jaata hoon. Bhainsein mujh mein lotein, aur kamal mujh mein hi khile. Kya hoon?
hint: Cricket ground geela ho jaaye toh yahi banta hai.

riddle: Gulaab ki pehredaar hoon, chhoone waale ko chupke se chubh jaati hoon. Babool aur cactus pe meri bheed. Pair mein ghus jaaun toh sui se nikaalte ho, aur machhli khaate waqt bhi gale mein atak jaaun. Kya hoon?
hint: Raasta phoolon bhara na ho toh isse bhara hota hai.

riddle: Khet mein ghutnon tak paani mein ugta hoon, chhilka utra toh safed daana ban ke thaali mein aaya. Daal ke saath meri pakki jodi, aur biryani, kheer, idli sab mujhse banein. Kya hoon?
hint: South India mein roti se zyada yahi chalta hai.

riddle: Peela hoon par haldi nahi, zameen ki gehraai se nikalta hoon. Shaadi mein sabse zyada meri poochh, mera daam roz news mein, aur mujhe kabhi jang nahi lagti. Kya hoon?
hint: Olympic mein first aane pe milta hai.

riddle: Taang ke beech ka jod. Baitho toh mud jaaye, chalo toh seedha. Budhaape mein dard kare, aur bachpan mein gire toh sabse pehle yahi chhile. Kya hai?
hint: Cricket mein pad isi ko bachaata hai.

riddle: Chehre ke beech ek chhota pahaad, neeche do gufaayein. Khushboo pehchaane, sardi mein behne lage. Kya hai?
hint: Sardi mein rumaal ki sabse zyada zaroorat isi ko.

riddle: Battis safed sipahi, gulaabi qile mein qaid. Roti aaye toh kaat daalein, meetha zyada ho toh dard ki shikaayat. Kaun hain?
hint: Dentist inka doctor hai.

riddle: Ek thaili jo bharo toh bhi teen ghante mein phir khaali. Khaali ho toh gurr gurr kare, zyada bhar do toh dard kare. Shaadi ki daawat mein sabse pehle yahi haar maane. Kya hai?
hint: Ajwain aur chooran isi ke dost hain.

riddle: Sir ke dono taraf ek ek seep, sab kuch sunein par ek shabd na bolein. Chashma inhi ke sahaare tike. Kya hain?
hint: Earphones inme lagte hain.

riddle: Kaato toh dard nahi, bina kahe badhte jaayein. Jawaani mein kaale, budhaape mein safed, kabhi kabhi bina bataaye chale jaayein. Kya hain?
hint: Nai ki dukaan pe inka hisaab hota hai.

riddle: Ek hi ghar mein paanch bhai, koi chhota koi lamba. Sabse mota sabse alag baithe. Mil jaayein toh mutthi ban jaaye. Kaun hain?
hint: Anguthi inhi mein pehnate hain.

riddle: Sir aur dhad ke beech ka pul. Tie aur haar yahin baandhe jaate hain, laptop pe jhuke raho toh akad jaaye. Jiraaf ki sabse lambi hoti hai. Kya hai?
hint: Muffler isi ko sardi se bachaata hai.

riddle: Garmi mein bina bulaaye maathe pe aaun, gym mein toh full time naukri. Namkeen boondein, kapdon pe daag chhod jaaun, aur pankhe ki hawa lagte hi thandi pad jaaun. Kya hoon?
hint: Deodorant isi ki badboo se ladta hai.

riddle: Naak mein gudgudi hui aur achaanak dhamaaka! Aankhein apne aap band ho jaayein, koi bole bless you. Kaali mirch soongho ya dhool ude toh turant aa jaaye. Kya hai?
hint: Kehte hain nikalte waqt aa jaaye toh do minute ruk jaao.

riddle: Roz raat chupke se aaye, aankhein band karwaaye. Jitna bulao utna door bhaage, par boring meeting mein bina bulaaye aa jaaye. Kya hai?
hint: Isme sapne aate hain.

riddle: Na dikhe na haath aaye, phir bhi deewar ke paar pahunch jaaye. Zukaam mein bhaari, cheekh mein oonchi. Kya hai?
hint: Gaane waalon ki sabse badi daulat.

riddle: Pet mein chuhe daudaaun, subah se kuch na khaaya ho toh gussa bana doon. Khaane ki khushboo aaye toh aur badh jaaun, pet bhar jaaye toh gaayab. Kya hoon?
hint: Isme log hangry ho jaate hain.

riddle: Haath ke beech ka mod. Chaahe jitni koshish karo, ise apni jeebh se nahi chhoo sakte. Kisi cheez se takraaye toh aisa current lage ki poora haath jhanjhana jaaye. Kya hai?
hint: Metro ki bheed mein doosron ki yahi chubhti hai.

riddle: Mitti ka gol pet, upar ek patli si jeb. Sikke daalo toh khan khan karke khush, paise nikaalne hon toh mujhe todna padta hai. Bachchon ka pehla bank. Kya hoon?
hint: Angrezi mein ise ek jaanwar ke naam se jaante hain.

riddle: Lohe ka mota dibba, pet mein gehne aur note chhupaaye. Taala bhi, number wala lock bhi, phir bhi chor ki nazar sabse pehle isi pe. Kya hai?
hint: Bank ke vault mein iske bade bhai rehte hain.

riddle: Sui ki aankh mein ghus ke phate kapde jode, patang ke saath aasman chhoo le. Rakhi bhi mujhse bane. Ek baar uljha toh suljhaane mein ghanta lag jaaye. Kya hoon?
hint: Darzi ki reel pe lipta rehta hai.

riddle: Ek hi sui, par sau haathon se tez. Pair se paddle maaro toh tak tak tak kapda silta jaaye. Darzi ki dukaan ki jaan, aur Usha ne ise ghar ghar pahunchaaya. Kya hai?
hint: Mummy isse school uniform ki hem theek karti thi.

riddle: Sheeshe ki chimney, neeche mitti ke tel ka pet, beech mein baati. Haath mein latkaake gaon ki galiyon mein raat ko raasta dikhaaye. Bijli aane se pehle har ghar ki roshni. Kya hai?
hint: Hawa mein bhi nahi bujhti, isliye kheton mein le jaate the.

riddle: Ped ki daali pe do rassiyan baandho, neeche patta rakho, aur saawan mein hawa se baatein karo. Aage jaao, peeche aao, par pahuncho kahin nahi. Kya hai?
hint: Park mein iske liye bachchon ki line lagti hai.

riddle: Ulti katori, andar latki ek chhoti si jeebh. Hilaao toh tan tan bole. School mein aakhri baar baje toh sab bhaagein, aur cycle pe iski chhoti behen tring tring kare. Kya hai?
hint: Doorbell isi ka naya roop hai.

riddle: Waqt ke ek pal ko hamesha ke liye qaid kar loon. Na hansun na bolun, par mujhe dekh ke har koi purani yaadon mein kho jaaye. Pehle album mein rehti thi, ab phone ki gallery mein hazaaron. Kya hoon?
hint: Kehte hain cheese bolo toh achhi aati hai.

riddle: Na aankh, na chehra, na koi tasveer, phir bhi gaane sunaaye aur khabrein bataaye. Pehle poora mohalla cricket commentary sunne mere paas baithta tha, aaj gaadi mein RJ ki baatein sunaata hoon. Kya hoon?
hint: Vividh Bharati isi pe bajta tha.

riddle: Khajoor ke patton se buni, farsh pe bichh ke poore khaandaan ko bithaaye. Kaam khatam hote hi lapet ke kone mein khadi. Garmi ki dopahar is pe let jaao toh iske nishaan peeth pe chhap jaayein. Kya hai?
hint: Yoga mat ki desi daadi.

riddle: Chamakdaar jamuni chamdi, sir pe hari kaanton wali topi. Aag pe bhoon ke mera bharta bane, aur jo kabhi idhar kabhi udhar lud jaaye use thaali ka yahi kehte hain. Kya hai?
hint: Isi ke rang pe ek rang ka naam pada hai.

riddle: Kalaai pe gol gol saheliyaan, kaanch ki bani, haath hilaao toh khan khan. Shaadi mein haath bhar ke pehni jaayein, zor se dabao toh toot jaayein. Kya hain?
hint: Firozabad inke liye mashhoor hai.

riddle: Main chhed hi chhed se bani hoon, phir bhi pakad leti hoon. Machhuaare ki saathi, paani ko jaane doon par machhli ko nahi. Tennis court ke beech bhi main hi khadi. Kya hoon?
hint: Makdi bhi apna khud bunti hai.

riddle: Gol, chapti, steel ki chamak. Mujh pe roti, daal, sabzi aur katoriyan ek saath baithti hain. Rajasthani wali mein itna kuch aata hai ki pet bhar jaaye par main na bharun. Kya hoon?
hint: Restaurant mein unlimited wali bhi milti hai.

riddle: Lohe ki patli salaakhon ka chhota sa ghar, andar tota ya chidiya qaid. Daana paani sab milta hai, par darwaza khula mile toh panchhi furr. Kya hai?
hint: Circus mein sher bhi isi mein rehta tha.

riddle: Lohe ki lambi gardan, haath ko upar neeche karo toh pet se thanda paani ugle. Gaon mein nahaane aur bartan dhone ki line yahin lage. Kya hai?
hint: Bijli ke bina bhi zameen se paani nikaale.

riddle: Na saans le, na khaana khaaye, phir bhi chhoti bachchi use sulaaye, nahlaaye aur khilaaye. Plastic ki ho ya kapde ki, kuch toh aankhein bhi jhapkaayein. Bachpan mein iski shaadi bhi karwaate the. Kaun hai?
hint: Khilaunon ki dukaan ki rani.

riddle: Nadi ke is paar se us paar haath phailaaye khada. Khud ek kadam na chale, par sabko paar karaaye. Neeche paani, upar gaadiyaan. Kolkata ka Howrah wala sabse mashhoor. Kya hai?
hint: Iske neeche se naav guzarti hai.

riddle: Rassi lapeto, zor se zameen pe pheko, toh ek pair pe ghoom ghoom ke naache. Thak jaaye toh ladkhada ke gir jaaye. Kya hai?
hint: Purana desi khilauna.

riddle: Phoonk maaro toh mota, sui chubhao toh khatam. Dhaage se baandho toh aasman jaane ko bekaraar. Kya hai?
hint: Birthday party ki decoration.

riddle: Kaan ki lau se latakta chhota sa jhoomar, sir hilaao toh jhoom jhoom ke naache. Sone ka ho ya oxidised chaandi ka, lehenge ke saath iske bina look adhoora. Kya hai?
hint: Kaan chhidwaane ke baad hi pehen sakte ho.

riddle: Kaagaz pe likhi dil ki baat, lifaafe mein band ho ke sheher sheher ghoome. Daakiya le ke aaye, WhatsApp ne iska dhandha chheena. Kya hai?
hint: Post box mein daali jaati thi.

riddle: Safed chamakte daane, namak ke hamshakal par swaad ulta. Chai mein ghul ke gaayab ho jaaun, cheentiyaan mujhe kahin se bhi dhoondh lein. Diabetes mein doctor mujhse door rehne ko bole. Kya hoon?
hint: Ganne ke ras se banti hai.

riddle: Bhoori tedhi phali, andar khatta-meetha chipchipa gooda aur chamakdaar beej. Naam sunte hi muh mein paani aa jaaye, aur samose ki meethi chutney bhi isi se bane. Kya hai?
hint: School ke bahar thele pe namak-mirch ke saath milti thi.

riddle: Lamba, hara, andar se thanda aur paani se bhara. Salad ki plate ka hero, aur gol gol kaat ke parlour mein aankhon pe bhi rakha jaata hoon. Kya hoon?
hint: Raite mein kaddukas karke daalte hain.

riddle: Lambi, patli, gaanth lagao toh aur mazboot. Kuen se balti kheenche, aur tug of war mein dono team ise kheenchein. Kya hai?
hint: Kapde sukhaane ke bhi kaam aati hai.

riddle: Do palde, beech mein ek kaanta. Jo bhaari ho woh neeche jhuke, jo halka woh upar. Sabzi wale ka imaandaar saathi. Kya hai?
hint: Kilo ki baat ho toh ise hi poochho.

riddle: Baans ka patla tukda, badan mein saat chhed. Hawa phoonko toh meethe geet gaaye. Kya hai?
hint: Hariprasad Chaurasia ka pyaara saaz.

riddle: Pairon mein chaandi ki zanjeer, chalo toh chhan chhan. Chupke se aane waale ki chugli kar de. Kya hai?
hint: Ghunghroo ki chhoti behen.

riddle: Dono taraf khaal ki chaadar, beech mein lakdi ka pet. Haathon se thaap do toh ladies sangeet mein aunties naachne lag jaayein. Gale mein latkaao ya god mein rakho. Kya hoon?
hint: Shaadi ke geeton ki jaan.

riddle: Sheher se sheher tak jaaye, par khud ek inch na hile. Seene pe gaadiyaan daudein, aur baarish mein gaddhe ho jaayein. Kya hai?
hint: Zebra crossing isi pe banti hai.

riddle: Bahar se hari chamdi, andar safed ya gulaabi gooda, aur chhote chhote sakht beej jo daant mein phans jaayein. Thele wala kaat ke namak mirch chhidak ke de. Kya hai?
hint: Tote ka favourite phal.

riddle: Paani mein dubo do toh gaayab, khaane mein na ho toh sab pheeka. Zyada ho jaaye toh bhi mummy ki daant. Samundar se aata hai. Kya hai?
hint: Sabse sasta masala, par sabse zaroori.

riddle: Sabse wafaadaar dost, raat bhar gali ki chaukidaari kare. Khush ho toh poonch hilaaye, ajnabi dekhe toh bhaun bhaun. Ek roti do toh zindagi bhar yaad rakhe. Kaun hai?
hint: Postman se iski purani dushmani hai.

riddle: Jungle mein chaukanni chaal, sher dikhe toh lambi chhalaang maar ke gaayab. Kuch ke sir pe shaakhon jaise seeng, aur aankhein itni sundar ki shaayari mein jagah paayein. Kaun hai?
hint: Bambi bhi yahi tha.

riddle: Ped ke tane se latka kaanton wala bhaari dibba, uthao toh kamar dukh jaaye. Kaato toh chipchipa doodh haathon se chipak jaaye. Kachcha ho toh veg mutton wali sabzi, pakka ho toh meetha phal. Kya hai?
hint: Ped pe lagne wala duniya ka sabse bada phal.

riddle: Na darwaza, na khidki, andar safed deewar ke peeche peela sona chhupa. Ek baar toot jaaye toh koi jod na paaye. Kya hai?
hint: Pehle yeh aaya ya murgi?

riddle: Pehle main hari, gol aur rasili thi. Dhoop mein baith baith ke sukh gayi, jhurriyaan pad gayi, par meethaas aur badh gayi. Ab kheer aur pulao mein tairti hoon. Kya hoon?
hint: Dry fruit ke dibbe ki sabse sasti sadasya.

riddle: Main ped ka rasoiya hoon: dhoop, hawa aur paani se khaana banaata hoon, par khud ek nivaala nahi khaata. Mausam badle toh peela pad ke naukri se nikaal diya jaata hoon. Kaun hoon?
hint: Taash ka bhi hota hai aur chai ki bhi.

riddle: Nanhe karigar phoolon se chura chura ke banaayein, saalon rakh do phir bhi kharab na ho. Chipchipa aur sunehra. Kya hai?
hint: Bhaalu iska deewana hai.

riddle: Chaar khambe, do soop jaise kaan, aage lamba ajgar latkaaye. Jungle ka sabse bhaari bhaiya. Kaun hai?
hint: Iski yaaddasht mashhoor hai.

riddle: Lambe kaan, laal aankhein, naak hilaati rehti. Gaajar ka deewana, aur race mein beech mein so gaya toh kachhue se haar gaya. Kaun?
hint: Jaadugar ki topi se nikalta hai.

riddle: Sir pe laal kalgi, alarm clock se pehle kukdoo koo. Gaon ka woh chaukidaar jo sooraj ke saath sabko jagaaye. Kaun?
hint: Iski baang se gaon jaagta hai.

riddle: Na nahaaye phir bhi hamesha geeli, bina pair ke tair tair ke ghoome. Paani se bahar nikaalo toh tadapne lage. Kaun?
hint: Aquarium mein rakhte hain.

riddle: Bina pair ke chale, bina haath ke shikaar kare. Jeebh ke do sire, aur been baje toh sar hilaaye. Kaun hai?
hint: Sapera ise tokri mein rakhta hai.

riddle: Chhat pe daana chugne aaye, gutur gutur gaaye. Purane zamaane mein pair mein chitthi baandh ke door bheja jaata tha. Grey rang, gardan pe hari-jamuni chamak. Kaun?
hint: Gateway of India pe jhund mein milte hain.

riddle: Dhobi ka saathi, peeth pe bojh laade. Kaam sabse zyada, izzat sabse kam, dhenchu dhenchu gaaye. Kisi ko bewakoof bolna ho toh mera naam le lete ho. Kaun?
hint: Isse ghoda samajhne ki galti mat karna.

riddle: Kaale baadal dekh ke pankh phaila ke naache, pankhon pe chaand jaisi aankhen. Par apne pair dekh ke udaas ho jaaye. Kaun?
hint: Bharat ka rashtriya pakshi.

riddle: Bina bulaaye mithai pe aa baithe, haath ragad ragad ke plan banaaye. Bhagaao toh ek chakkar maar ke wahin wapas. Bhin bhin kare par dank nahi. Kaun?
hint: Jaali wale darwaze isi ke liye lagte hain.

riddle: Aath pair, aage do chimte, aur poonch upar mud ke dank taiyaar. Registaan mein patthar ke neeche chhupe, joote mein ghus jaaye toh kahaani ban jaaye. Kaun?
hint: Ek rashi ka nishaan bhi yahi hai.

riddle: Dikhne mein chhota aur chapta, gadde aur charpai ki daraaron mein ghar banaaye. Raat bhar chupke se khoon chuse, aur subah tum khujaate raho. Kaun?
hint: Hostel ke purane gaddon ka kiraayedaar.

riddle: Mere ghar mein sau khaane. Kahin pahuncho toh seedha upar chadh jaao, kahin kisi ke muh mein aao toh phisal ke neeche. Paasa hi meri kismat likhta hai, aur 99 pe aake neeche girna sabse bura. Kya hoon?
hint: Ludo ke board ke peeche aksar yahi chhapa hota hai.

riddle: Hara rang, lambi mudi hui pichhli taangein, ghaas mein chhupa rahe. Paas jaao toh ek chhalaang mein gaayab. Iske bhai bade jhund mein aayein toh poore khet chaat jaayein. Kaun?
hint: Ek chhalaang mein apne badan se kai guna door.

riddle: Chhota sa, bhoora, lambi jhabbedaar poonch aur phurti bijli jaisi. Saanp ka sabse bada dushman, dono ki ladai dekhne madaari ke paas bheed lagti thi. Kaun?
hint: Rikki-Tikki-Tavi yahi tha.

riddle: Mooch hai par aadmi nahi, doodh chupke se pee jaaye. Raasta kaat de toh log ruk jaayein, aur girti hamesha pairon ke bal hai. Kaun?
hint: Chuhe iske naam se kaanpte hain.

riddle: Daali daali jhoole, sabki nakal utaare. Shimla mein tourist ka chashma aur kela chheen ke bhaag jaaye. Kaun?
hint: Madaari isko nachaata tha.

riddle: Peeth pe teen dhaariyaan, jhabbedaar poonch. Do haathon mein daana pakad ke kutre, aur ped pe fudak fudak ke chadhe. Kaun?
hint: Park mein bench ke paas daana maangti milegi.

riddle: Peeth pe kavach, aage do chimte. Samundar kinaare seedha nahi, hamesha tedha tedha bhaage. Kaun?
hint: Cancer rashi ka nishaan.

riddle: Deewar aur chhat pe ulta chal le, tubelight ke paas keedon ka shikaar kare. Pakdo toh poonch chhod ke bhaag jaaye. Kaun?
hint: Isse darne waale log bahut hain.

riddle: Na haath, na pair, na ek bhi haddi. Mitti kha kha ke kheti sudhaare, baarish mein zameen se bahar aa jaaye. Kaun?
hint: Kisaan ka dost kehlaata hai.

riddle: Na daant dikhe na dard ho, chupke se chipak ke khoon peeti rahe aur phool ke moti ho jaaye. Jo log peechha hi na chhodein, unhe bhi isi ka naam dete hain. Kaun?
hint: Taalaab mein nahaao toh pair pe chipak jaati hai.

riddle: Kaala rang, kaan-kaan ki awaaz. Pyaas lagi toh ghade mein kankad daal daal ke paani upar le aaya. Kaun?
hint: Chhat pe bole toh kehte hain mehmaan aayenge.

riddle: Rang mera kauwe jaisa kaala, par gala sabse meetha. Aam ke mausam mein kuhu kuhu gaaun, par apne ande doosre ke ghonsle mein chhod aaun. Kaun?
hint: Achhi gaayika ko isi ka naam dete hain.

riddle: Nadi mein lakdi ki tarah chupchaap pade, bade bade daant. Jhoothe aansu bahaane ka muhavara isi ke naam pe hai. Kaun?
hint: Bandar aur iski dosti ki Panchatantra kahani.

riddle: Main rassi ki mutthi hoon. Jitna kheencho utni kas jaaun. Rumaal mein bandh ke kuch yaad dilaaun, aur rishte mein pad jaaun toh daant se bhi na khuloon. Kya hoon?
hint: Shaadi mein dulha dulhan ke kapdon mein bhi baandhi jaati hai.

riddle: Main suraj ki roshni udhaar leke raat ko chhaton pe bichhaati hoon, par thandi karke. Taj Mahal mujh mein sabse sundar lagta hai, aur Dilli ka ek purana bazaar mera naam liye baitha hai. Kya hoon?
hint: Poonam ki raat sabse zyada hoti hai.

riddle: Main ghoomta rehta hoon par kahin jaata nahi. Mere sir pe geeli mitti ka gola rakho toh haathon ke ishaare pe diya, matka, kulhad sab ban jaaye. Kumhaar mere bina adhoora. Kya hoon?
hint: Pottery class mein iske saamne haath gande hote hain.

riddle: Main samundar ki beti, kinaare se milne daud ke aati hoon, par milte hi toot jaati hoon aur phir peechhe hat ke nayi taiyaari karti hoon. Stadium mein log bhi khade ho ho ke mujhe banaate hain. Kaun hoon?
hint: Surfing isi pe hoti hai.

riddle: Main kaali hoon par koyla nahi, diye ki lau pe ulti katori rakho toh paida hoti hoon. Aankhon ke kinaare rehti hoon, aur nazar se bachaane ke liye kaan ke peeche ek teeka bhi main hi. Kya hoon?
hint: Heroine ki aankhon ki dhaar isi se.

riddle: Til se nikla, sarson se nikla, par main na beej na phool. Kadhai mein garam hoke pakode tairaaun, sar mein maalish karwaaun. Paani ke saath rehta hoon par kabhi ghulta nahi, hamesha upar tairta hoon. Kya hoon?
hint: Gaadi ki service mein ise bhi badalte hain.

riddle: Ek ped ki baarah daaliyaan, har daali pe tees ke aas paas patte, aur har patta aadha safed aadha kaala. Poora ped jhad jaaye toh log aadhi raat patake phod ke jashn manaayein. Yeh ped kya hai?
hint: January mein naya lagta hai.

riddle: Mera pet ek gehra gaddha, aur mera saathi ek mota danda. Woh roz mujhe koote, main chupchaap sahoon, aur kooti elaichi ki khushboo poore ghar mein phail jaaye. Muhavare mein log mujh mein sir de dete hain. Kya hoon?
hint: Iske saathi ko moosal kehte hain.

riddle: Main khidki ki palkein hoon. Suraj ko andar aane se rokun, padosi ki nazar se bachaaun. Hawa chale toh naachoon, aur natak khatam hote hi mujhe hi gira diya jaata hai. Kya hoon?
hint: Kisi baat ko chhupaane ke muhavare mein bhi aata hai.

riddle: Mera ek sir hai, ek poonch, par na jaanwar hoon na insaan. Pair nahi phir bhi haath haath ghoomta hoon, aur jeb mein khan khan karta hoon. Kaun hoon?
hint: Faisla na ho paaye toh mujhe uchhaalo.

riddle: Kaali hoon par kauwa nahi, lambi hoon par saanp nahi. Teen hisson ko gooth ke banti hoon, peeth pe latak ke jhoolti hoon, aur school mein laal ribbon se bandhti thi. Kya hoon?
hint: Rapunzel ki sabse lambi thi.

riddle: Na mistri aaya na cement laga, phir bhi tinka tinka jod ke ek ghar ban gaya. Daali ke beech tika hai, andar ande sote hain, aur bachche ud jaayein toh sunsaan. Kya hai?
hint: Beijing ka Olympic stadium isi naam se mashhoor hai.

riddle: Log kehte hain mere bhi kaan hote hain, par main kuch nahi sunti. Mujh pe likhna mana hai, phir bhi log likh jaate hain. China wali meri behen itni lambi ki poori duniya mein mashhoor hai. Kya hoon?
hint: Amitabh ki ek mashhoor 1975 wali film ka naam.

riddle: Do lohe ki behnein saath saath sau meel chalti hain par kabhi gale nahi milti. Beech mein cement ki seedhiyaan bichhi, aur upar se dhadak dhadak karti lambi gaadi guzre. Kya hain?
hint: Crossing pe phaatak inhi ke liye girta hai.

riddle: Main jhukti hoon tabhi kaam aati hoon. Meri dori peeche kheencho aur chhod do, toh mera patla saathi hawa cheerta hua nishaane pe ja lage. Archery waale mujhe haath mein thaamte hain. Kya hoon?
hint: Deepika Kumari iski champion hai.

riddle: Sakht lakdi jaisi khopdi mein band, andar se bilkul dimaag jaisa dikhta hoon. Kashmir ke pedon pe latakta hoon aur todne ke liye hathoda chahiye. Kaun?
hint: Dry fruit ke dibbe mein milta hai.

riddle: Main kisi ko dikhti nahi, zameen mein dabi rehti hoon, par poori imaarat mere kandhon pe khadi hai. Main kamzor ho jaaun toh sabse oonchi building bhi dagmagaaye. Pehla patthar mujh mein hi rakha jaata hai. Kya hoon?
hint: Kisi rishte ya company ki shuruaat ko bhi yahi kehte hain.

riddle: Main chalti hoon par mere pair nahi, chaar logon ke kandhe hi mere pair hain. Andar pardon ke peechhe dulhan ya raani baithti thi, aur bahar se log taal mein kadam milaate. Kya hoon?
hint: Aaj bhi kuch shaadiyon mein dulhan isme vida hoti hai.

riddle: Main pahaad ke pet mein ghusi hui sadak hoon. Andar jaate hi dopahar mein bhi raat ho jaaye, aur train mujh mein se seeti bajaate hue nikle. Kya hoon?
hint: Metro bhi sheher ke neeche isi mein chalti hai.

riddle: Mujh mein ghusna aasaan, nikalna mushkil. Deewaron ke beech raaste hi raaste, par sahi sirf ek. Lucknow wala mera sabse mashhoor desi roop hai. Kya hoon?
hint: Akshay Kumar ki ek horror comedy ka naam.

riddle: Saabun ke paani mein phoonk maaro toh paida hota hoon, dhoop mein satrangi chamakta hoon, hawa mein tairta hoon. Par kisi ne ungli lagaayi toh meri zindagi wahin khatam. Kya hoon?
hint: Soda ki bottle kholo toh inki fauj nikalti hai.

riddle: Main samundar ki tijori hoon, do dhakkan wala sakht dibba. Ret ka ek kan andar ghus jaaye toh main use saalon tak lapet lapet ke anmol bana doon. Kya hoon?
hint: Kinaare pe bachche iske khaali ghar bator ke laate hain.

riddle: Main aag ki aakhri nishaani hoon: sab jal jaaye tab main bachti hoon. Hawa mein ud jaaun, purane zamaane mein bartan maanjne ke kaam aati thi, aur angithi thandi ho toh bas main hi rehti hoon. Kya hoon?
hint: Ashtray isi ke liye bana hai.

riddle: Na cement laga, na coal tar, na koi mazdoor aaya, phir bhi log chal chal ke hi mujhe bana dete hain. Khet ke beech ya park ki ghaas mein ek patli si nangi lakeer. Kya hoon?
hint: Pahaadon mein trekking inhi pe hoti hai.

riddle: Do naram parde, peeche battis sipahi. Parde khulein toh baatein nikle, band ho jaayein toh raaz chhupe. Parde kya hain?
hint: Lipstick inhi pe lagti hai.

riddle: Zameen mein ek gol ghar jiski chhat hi nahi, darwaza seedha aasman ki taraf khulta hai. Khaali balti utre, bhari balti chadhe, aur andar chillao toh jawaab aaye. Kya hai?
hint: Mendhak iska sabse mashhoor nivaasi.

riddle: Main nadi ka raasta rokta hoon par use maarta nahi, peeche ek badi jheel bana deta hoon. Mere darwaaze khulein toh neeche shor machta hai, aur meri taaqat se sheheron mein bijli jalti hai. Kya hoon?
hint: Bhakra Nangal sabse mashhoor desi naam hai.
